# Data Model: Server Browser v1

**Feature**: 026-server-browser
**Date**: 2025-12-17

## Entities

### ServerEntry (plix-common/server_browser/types.rs)

Represents a game server in the master directory.

```rust
/// A game server entry in the master server directory
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct ServerEntry {
    /// Unique stable identifier (hash of host:port, generated by master)
    pub server_id: String,
    /// Display name of the server
    pub name: String,
    /// IP address or hostname
    pub host: String,
    /// Game port
    pub port: u16,
    /// Geographic region (e.g., "eu-west", "us-east")
    pub region: String,
    /// Descriptive tags (e.g., ["ctf", "competitive"])
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    /// Current player count
    pub player_count: u8,
    /// Maximum player capacity
    pub max_players: u8,
    /// Supported game modes
    pub game_modes: Vec<String>,
    /// Protocol version for compatibility filtering
    pub protocol_version: String,
    /// Timestamp of last heartbeat (Unix epoch seconds)
    pub last_seen: u64,
}
```

**Validation Rules**:
- `name`: 1-64 characters, alphanumeric + spaces + hyphens + underscores
- `host`: Valid IP or hostname, 1-255 characters
- `port`: 1-65535
- `region`: 1-32 characters, alphanumeric + hyphens
- `tags`: Max 10 tags, each 1-32 characters
- `player_count`: 0-255, must be <= max_players
- `max_players`: 1-255
- `game_modes`: Max 10 modes, each 1-32 characters
- `protocol_version`: Non-empty string

### HeartbeatRequest (plix-master/types.rs)

Data sent by game server to register/update with master.

```rust
/// Heartbeat payload sent by game servers to master
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct HeartbeatRequest {
    /// Display name of the server
    pub name: String,
    /// IP address or hostname (can be auto-detected by master)
    pub host: String,
    /// Game port
    pub port: u16,
    /// Geographic region
    pub region: String,
    /// Descriptive tags
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    /// Current player count
    pub player_count: u8,
    /// Maximum player capacity
    pub max_players: u8,
    /// Supported game modes
    pub game_modes: Vec<String>,
    /// Protocol version
    pub protocol_version: String,
}
```

### HeartbeatResponse (plix-master/types.rs)

Response from master after processing heartbeat.

```rust
/// Response to heartbeat request
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct HeartbeatResponse {
    /// Whether the heartbeat was accepted
    pub success: bool,
    /// Assigned server_id (for logging purposes)
    pub server_id: String,
    /// Error message if success is false
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub error: Option<String>,
}
```

### ServerListResponse (plix-common/server_browser/types.rs)

Response from master for server list query.

```rust
/// Response containing list of active servers
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ServerListResponse {
    /// List of active server entries
    pub servers: Vec<ServerEntry>,
    /// Total count (may differ from servers.len() if pagination added later)
    pub total: usize,
    /// Timestamp of response (Unix epoch seconds)
    pub timestamp: u64,
}
```

### FavoriteServer (plix-client/server_browser/favorites.rs)

Local favorite server entry.

```rust
/// A favorited server stored locally
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct FavoriteServer {
    /// Server ID (hash of host:port)
    pub server_id: String,
    /// Cached name for display when offline
    pub name: String,
    /// Host address
    pub host: String,
    /// Port number
    pub port: u16,
    /// When the favorite was added (Unix epoch seconds)
    pub added_at: u64,
}
```

### FavoritesConfig (plix-client/server_browser/favorites.rs)

Root structure for favorites TOML file.

```rust
/// Root structure for servers.toml
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct FavoritesConfig {
    /// List of favorite servers
    #[serde(default)]
    pub favorites: Vec<FavoriteServer>,
    /// Browser settings
    #[serde(default)]
    pub settings: BrowserSettings,
}

/// Browser settings
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct BrowserSettings {
    /// Master server URL
    #[serde(default = "default_master_url")]
    pub master_url: String,
}

fn default_master_url() -> String {
    "http://localhost:8080".to_string()
}

impl Default for BrowserSettings {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            master_url: default_master_url(),
        }
    }
}
```

### MasterConfig (plix-server/master_announce/config.rs)

Configuration for game server's master announcement.

```rust
/// Configuration for master server announcement
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct MasterConfig {
    /// Master server URL (e.g., "http://master.plix.game:8080")
    pub master_url: String,
    /// Server display name
    pub server_name: String,
    /// Geographic region
    pub region: String,
    /// Descriptive tags
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    /// Whether to advertise to master
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// Heartbeat interval in seconds (default: 20)
    #[serde(default = "default_heartbeat_interval")]
    pub heartbeat_interval_secs: u64,
}

fn default_heartbeat_interval() -> u64 {
    20
}
```

### ServerRegistry (plix-master/state.rs)

In-memory state for master server.

```rust
/// In-memory server registry
pub struct ServerRegistry {
    /// Map of server_id -> ServerEntry
    servers: RwLock<HashMap<String, ServerEntry>>,
    /// Rate limit tracking: IP -> timestamps of recent requests
    rate_limits: RwLock<HashMap<IpAddr, Vec<Instant>>>,
    /// TTL for server entries in seconds
    ttl_secs: u64,
    /// Max requests per IP per minute
    rate_limit_per_minute: u32,
}
```

## Relationships

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Master Server                             │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │              ServerRegistry                              │    │
│  │  servers: HashMap<server_id, ServerEntry>               │    │
│  │  rate_limits: HashMap<IpAddr, Vec<Instant>>             │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
└──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                           │ HTTP API
           ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
           │                               │
           ▼                               ▼
┌──────────────────────┐       ┌──────────────────────┐
│    Game Server       │       │      Client          │
│  ┌────────────────┐  │       │  ┌────────────────┐  │
│  │ MasterConfig   │  │       │  │ FavoritesConfig│  │
│  │ (toml/cli)     │  │       │  │ (servers.toml) │  │
│  └────────────────┘  │       │  └────────────────┘  │
│         │            │       │         │            │
│         ▼            │       │         ▼            │
│  HeartbeatRequest ───┼───────┼──► ServerListResponse│
│  (POST /heartbeat)   │       │  (GET /servers)      │
└──────────────────────┘       └──────────────────────┘
```

## State Transitions

### Server Entry Lifecycle

```
[Not Registered] ──POST /heartbeat──► [Active]
                                         │
                                         │ heartbeat (every 20s)
                                         ▼
                                      [Active]
                                         │
                                         │ no heartbeat for 60s
                                         ▼
                                      [Expired] ──cleanup──► [Removed]
```

### Favorite Server Lifecycle

```
[Not Favorited] ──/favorite <index>──► [Favorited]
                                            │
                                            │ /unfavorite <index>
                                            ▼
                                       [Not Favorited]
```

## File Locations

| Entity | Storage | Path |
|--------|---------|------|
| ServerEntry | In-memory (master) | N/A |
| FavoritesConfig | File | `~/.config/plix/servers.toml` |
| MasterConfig | CLI args or env | N/A (runtime only) |

## Index Strategies

### Master Server (in-memory)

- Primary key: `server_id` (HashMap key)
- No secondary indexes needed for MVP
- Full scan acceptable for 1000 servers

### Client Favorites

- Lookup by `server_id` for checking if favorited
- Linear scan acceptable for ~100 favorites
